phase_name: Phase 15-7 integrated_decision Measurement Execution Record Template
phase_japanese_name: Phase 15-7 integrated_decision 測定実行記録テンプレート
purpose: Design the authoritative execution record template for Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement workflow, providing a structured capture format for measurement inputs, execution steps, results, and post-measurement state transition record

template_usage_notes.when_to_use: Fill this template at the time Phase 15-7 measurement workflow actually executes (after Phase 18-8 AUTHORIZE_FULL or AUTHORIZE_PHASE_15_7_ONLY is signed and Phase 18-6 final ABORT verification passes)
template_usage_notes.template_status: DESIGN_TEMPLATE (not yet filled; actual execution not yet authorized)
template_usage_notes.filling_authority: Authority who signed Phase 18-8 launch authorization (or explicitly delegated role)

section_1_execution_preamble.description: Record of execution preconditions and gate clearance immediately before measurement

phase_18_8_authorization_reference.description: signed_authorization_id from Phase 18-8 that authorized this execution

execution_start_timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp when Phase 15-7 measurement workflow execution began

executing_authority_identifier.description: Unique identifier of authority executing the measurement

integrated_decision_before.description: Must be NO_GO immediately before execution

section_2_measurement_scope_definition.description: Definition of what integrated_decision measures and what criteria govern GO/NO_GO outcome

measurement_target.description: What is being measured: integrated_decision gate for app/tests implementation unlock
measurement_target.template_value: Evaluate whether all prerequisite conditions for generic_block_ai app/tests implementation are met

measurement_method.template_value: Evaluate 10 gate conditions from Phase 16-3 (blocking + readiness conditions) against current system state

go_criteria.description: Conditions that must ALL be true for integrated_decision = GO

criteria.criterion: All Phase 16 blocking conditions cleared (6 conditions from Phase 16-3)
All Phase 16 readiness conditions met (7 conditions from Phase 16-3)
Phase 17 gate conditions all PROCEED (from Phase 17-2 6-gate evaluation)
No blocking conditions reactivated since Phase 18-6 final check

no_go_criteria.description: If any of these are true, integrated_decision remains NO_GO

criteria.criterion: Any Phase 16 blocking condition still active
Any Phase 17-2 gate in HOLD or HALT status
Phase 18-2 check status HOLD_PENDING or HALT_BLOCKERS
Phase 18-6 ABORT condition detected at execution time

section_3_measurement_execution_steps.description: Step-by-step execution log for Phase 15-7 measurement

steps.action: Open audit trail for Phase 15-7 execution. Record execution_record_id and start timestamp.
Evaluate all Phase 16-3 blocking conditions (6 conditions) against current state
Evaluate all Phase 16-3 readiness conditions (7 conditions) against current state
Evaluate Phase 17-2 gate conditions (6 gates) for integrated_decision feasibility
Apply GO/NO_GO criteria and determine integrated_decision value
Record determined integrated_decision value and compute evidence hash for tamper-proofing
Close Phase 15-7 execution audit trail. Record end timestamp and final status.

section_4_measurement_result.description: Final result of Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement

integrated_decision_result.description: Result of Phase 15-7 measurement. Changes integrated_decision state if GO.

result_evidence_hash_sha256_plus.description: SHA-256+ hash of section_3 execution steps and section_4 results

integrated_decision_after.description: If measurement result=GO, this changes from NO_GO to GO

receiver_validator_permission_after.description: Unchanged by Phase 15-7 (only Phase 15-8 can change this)

app_implementation_status_after.description: If integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE → may transition. If only integrated_decision=GO without Phase 15-8 complete → still NO_GO.
app_implementation_status_after.note: NO_GO unless both Phase 15-7 and 15-8 complete with GO/EFFECTIVE

tests_implementation_status_after.note: NO_GO unless both Phase 15-7 and 15-8 complete with GO/EFFECTIVE

section_5_post_measurement_actions.description: Required actions after Phase 15-7 measurement completes

actions.action: Store execution record (this document) in immutable audit trail
Notify authority of measurement result via secure channel
If integrated_decision=GO: Proceed to Phase 19-3 (Phase 15-7/15-8 result consistency confirmation)
If integrated_decision=NO_GO: Document reason, escalate to Phase 18-5 HOLD/HALT procedure
Do not change app/tests implementation status without completing Phase 15-8 measurement first

phase_19_1_completion_criteria: Pre-execution preamble fields (state snapshot, authorization references) defined
Measurement scope (GO criteria, NO_GO criteria) defined
Measurement result and post-measurement state transition fields defined
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
